headline: Norwood Pond bridge work and controlled burn, Camp Paradise vernal pool at 44 Cole Street, and Cross Lane trail plans.
summary: Five boards and commissions will give updates. Ward 5 and Ward 6 open space issues come next, along with progress on the 7 Year Action Plan.
items: Updates from five boards and commissions
Ward 5: Norwood Pond Bridge construction, Assessors Map 82 Lot 9
Ward 5: purchase of materials from Tractor Supply Company
Ward 5: meeting with North Shore Music Theater (NSMT) about access to rear of property
Ward 5: Norwood Pond controlled burn, Assessors Map 82 Lot 9
Ward 6: trail extension from Sally Milligan to Cross Lane/Boyles Street intersection and trail rerouting or improvements on Cross Lane Soccer Field trail, Assessors Map 33 Parcels 7 and 6
Ward 6: initiatives around Camp Paradise facility and recent certification of vernal pool at 44 Cole Street, Assessors Map 45 Lot 42
Progress on goals from 7 Year Action Plan in 2022 City of Beverly Open Space Plan
Approval of 2027 Open Space and Recreation Committee meeting schedule
